name: Do Won Kim
roles: PhD Candidate in Information, University of Maryland
Student Affiliate, Institute for Trustworthy AI in Law & Society (TRAILS)
Advised by Giovanni Luca Ciampaglia and Cody Buntain
bio: I am a computational social scientist studying how the design of digital information environments shapes access to information, interactions with others, and political beliefs and behavior. Using computational methods and experiments, I aim to inform the design of platforms and AI systems that support informed decision-making, constructive engagement across differences, and democratic participation.
To learn more, see my Research page for current projects and publications, or read about my dissertation on how AI can strengthen democracy.
